book.name: 2 Koríndshucheema
book.title: 2 Koríndshucheema Papororini kuzizimun Koríndshucheem yandarangiya tsimbunurinshtini

content: Ashiriya, nuw Apanllee kuk istampani taakuri, nuw siyaa atashina; Paptsa; siy yuwaa Apanll Isusumun chiyaa nayanirangu anoo mazinarangus, iwaziri ngutis mangoonintspa; izuuru mangoonkus itsinsartam taangtsa atina.

Ngatintspa; naturit in mangoonangtsa. Naturi Apanll siyaa kutakcha. Zapshina paptsa tina. Waana Apanll áttanda; Siy nuwaa mashkus, istanda átus, Nuw siyaa tapachindachintspa. Nuw siyaa kapung istachintspa.
Watam natumasana siyaa nayanikinawa. Siyaam kamungshisheem wayarangina; zapshina tstsachparina, átcha Apanlli kuku. Ashiri naturi mangoonangtsa atina.
Mishat, tputs nuwaa yutaritam ínarundama aturi, wanasiriri taakuri yapstakina; xarashish nduncha.
Apanlltana wámachtashi. Apanll wamin kiyungutaa kachiykuri, ashiritaa nda sambaytakina. ¿Nuwaa wanipaja kiyung yacharangana?
Nuwaa pzkoorangana; putarangana; tsangarangana; tumanarangana. Apanllee kuk kapung mapeekuri, kanusamaam pinasarangina. Mapeekuri taraseerangi; misha mariz kayatarangina.
Apanllee kuk kamankuri, wanasiriri taaki; mangipti taakina; mangoonkina; apinll tayaspatakina; tputsee nayanikina. Apanllimun Wani kizpur taakina. Tputsee wanasiri chinakina.

Apanllee kuk itsinsaru kamankina. Apanll wizpuririni nuwaa istarangu, tputs zapan mangoonkana. Ashkuri, tputs nuwaa yutaritam ínamaam pinasakana; misha nuwamunatam yasaksin, tputssha nuwaa kuki mazinaksin, Apanllee mangoonkana.
Ashpatam tputs nuwaa kis chinakana; ashpatam nuwaa natsakana; ashpatam nuwaa yutaritam ínakana. Nuwaa wayangichirireemta ínaksin, ashiritaa itsinsaruri kamankina; ngichiz nduncha.
Tputs ichinguru nuwaa yasaktaatssin, itaru nuwaa niyrkana. Nuwaa pachamaam zandkitaatssin, wand kchit taakina. Nuwaa kizpuritaa waneeksin, itaru pachamaam xapookana.

Mangi mantsaktaati, itaru uru Apanllimun mangi kis taakina. Pukiritaati taakuri, itaru tputsee zapan istakina Apanllee mangoonamaama. Nduntaa maachi pakchiyam payukuri, ashiritaa nuwaam pishtats ndunpaz ashkiya.
Mazinangtsa nuw siyaa Koríndshucheetsis kizpur chinakuri, itsinsaru kamanirangina taarasheetsi; izuuru kamanirangina.
Nuw siyaam nda pakchiyam kamapshirangina; siyaa niyrarangeezi, nda. Itaru, siy nuwaa niyrarangsa.

Shirintspa. ¿Mayaamsha nuwaa pakchim chinaksa? Nuw siyaa chinaki ashiritam nda siy nuwaa chinaksa. Ipareepzi ashiruri siyaa waneekuri atina. Nuwaa kizpuritam chinangandama atina; nuwaa kuki payungtsa tina. Watam Apanll nuwaa Isusoom tayaspatampaneem ínaranguwa.
Mazinangantsa: minoo siyaa wanichintspa; tputs Apanllee nda mangoonku anpat kizpur amikurtarintspa; misha ngusirtarintspa yashingchichpata. Ashkachuch, ¿tamareeja kis taachich?
¿Tamareeja yutaritshishpanpat wanasir taachich? ¿Antaati kaschir psaanpat washunand taak? nda. Chiy tputsich Apanllchichich yashingchichpat taakuch ashikpaz ashiktichcha.
Min tputs Isusush tachiku, minsha tputs yashingush tachitchu, ¿ashiru tamareeja minamari mangooz payuchich? ¿Antaati pakchiyam tatsamooru chinacheezich? ndambaree.
Apanll waana iyash mangini taaku, Apanllpaz pangu ashiru taakani. ¿Tamareeja apanllputs iyapta ipunach? Kapunguri pinasakiya. Apanll waana, tárangiya;

content.text: Nuw siyash taakuri, nuwaa Apanllireemis ínatssa.
Siy nuwaa apartana tátssa; nuwsha siyaa ipartana táchtamma,

content: tárangiya Apanlli. Apanll wamari kasiru an nda mangu atiya.
